counterfactual_missing_items: No mention of other parasitic causes
No evidence of ocular involvement by aspergillosis
decisive_items: Right eye: focal eosinophil-rich inflammatory infiltrate in posterior choroid with larval sections
Left eye: focal eosinophil-rich inflammatory infiltrate in posteronasal choroid
Disseminated aspergillosis and candidiasis without ocular involvement
response.rationale: R3 is the only candidate directly supported by pathognomonic larval sections in the eye, which are the most specific finding. R2 is explicitly contradicted by the statement 'without ocular involvement' and does not explain the eosinophilic choroiditis. R1 is a predisposing condition, not the diagnosis. C1 is a redundant completion of R3.

rejected.why: Aspergillosis is explicitly stated to spare the eyes, so it cannot explain the ocular larval sections and eosinophilic infiltrates.
Hyper-IgE syndrome is a predisposing immunodeficiency, not the cause of the current ocular and systemic findings.
Redundant append-only completion of R3; adds no new diagnostic information beyond the parent candidate.
